title: Fishing in Eastern Africa
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Social Studies; not yet checked by a CBC Social Studies teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Facts: marine grounds in the Indian Ocean; inland Lake Victoria, Tanganyika, Malawi (Nyasa), Turkana; trawlers drag nets; purse seine nets circle a shoal.

skills.key_step: The child locates the marine and inland fishing grounds of Eastern Africa.

floor.question: What is Kenya's main inland fishing ground?

representations: a regional map with lakes and coast

board.do: Draw the coast and three lakes.

board.say: Is this marine or inland fishing?

misconceptions.ask: Which is a marine fishing ground?
misconceptions.repair: Ask whether the water is salty or fresh.

misconceptions.ask: Which fish comes from Lake Victoria?
misconceptions.repair: Match fish and water in a small table.
Find the lake on the regional map.
Write marine = sea beside a picture of the Indian Ocean.

checks.question: Name a marine fishing ground of Eastern Africa.
Name two inland fishing grounds.
checks.answer: any two of: Lake Victoria, Tanganyika, Malawi, Turkana

skills.key_step: The child describes traditional and modern methods of marine fishing.

floor.question: Is the Indian Ocean a marine or an inland ground?

board.do: Draw a circle of net around fish.
Point at the bottom of the net.
board.say: What happens when it is pulled closed?

listen_for: Fishing with a hook and line
A basket trap from a canoe
misconceptions.ask: Which is a modern method of fishing?
misconceptions.repair: Ask which has an engine and a freezer.

listen_for: A bag to carry fish home
misconceptions.repair: Draw the net circling the fish and closing like a drawstring purse.

misconceptions.ask: Which catches more fish: a trawler or a canoe with a basket?
misconceptions.repair: Compare the size of a trawler net and a basket.

checks.question: What is trawling?
checks.answer: dragging a net along the sea or sea bed behind a boat

checks.question: Give one traditional fishing method.
checks.answer: any of: hook and line, baskets, spears, small nets from canoes

skills.key_step: The child pairs fishing challenges with solutions.

floor.question: Describe trawling.
floor.answer: dragging a net behind a boat

board.do: Wait for cold rooms or ice.

misconceptions.repair: Ask what happens if you take all the eggs and young fish.

misconceptions.ask: What helps fish keep fresh before sale?
misconceptions.repair: Ask what spoils fish: thieves or heat?

listen_for: It helps; fish hide in it
misconceptions.ask: How does water hyacinth on Lake Victoria affect fishing?
misconceptions.repair: Show a photo of boats stuck in hyacinth at Kisumu.

listen_for: They do not; fish keep for days
misconceptions.ask: Why do some fishers lose fish before selling them?
misconceptions.repair: Compare dried fish with fresh fish left out for a day.

checks.question: Which solution fits overfishing?
checks.answer: licences, fishing seasons and mesh-size rules

checks.question: How does water hyacinth harm fishing?
checks.answer: blocks boats and reduces oxygen for fish
